data.cultural_impact: Zelimir is a Slavic name that has been used in various Central and Eastern European cultures for centuries. It is a name that carries the weight of hope, courage, and resilience. In Slavic folklore, the name is seen as a source of strength, reminding people that they are not alone in their struggles and that help and support can be found in their faith and community. It has been particularly popular in Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and other Slavic countries where it is still used today.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Zelimir holds a deep spiritual significance for those who bear it. It reflects the belief in the power of God to provide help and support in times of need. It is a reminder of the importance of faith and prayer in overcoming challenges and finding peace in the midst of difficulty. For some, the name is also a reminder of the importance of community and connection in providing support and encouragement. Ultimately, Zelimir is a name that embodies the idea that even in the darkest moments, God's help can be found, and peace can be attained.

historical_references.reference: Born in Croatia in the late 11th century, Zelimir was the ruler of the Croatian state from 1075 to 1089.
historical_references.context: Zelimir was a medieval ruler of Croatia.
